I manage the uniforms for the staff of a security company, which operates in more than 30 locations across the United States. The process of ordering uniforms has been incredibly smooth and hassle-free, thanks to Image First Uniforms. They not only receive the orders but also customize the uniforms with patches, label the boxes per person, and all I have to do is receive and distribute the uniforms to my staff. I am very grateful for their exceptional service.
settings.author: Valerie S.

settings.content: Thanks to Image First Uniforms, I can easily keep track of the orders my buyers place. I have around 10 buyers, and the ability to receive and approve orders before they are placed is fantastic. It really helps me manage everything efficiently.
settings.author: Tim H.

settings.content: They offer the option to create a customized portal for each company. Thanks to this feature, which includes products with customizations already applied, my buyers don't make mistakes. It's been a great help in ensuring everything runs smoothly.
